input_fields.name: toroidal_face
input_fields.description: One face identified as the toroidal fillet under review.

input_fields.name: fillet_association
input_fields.description: Evidence linking the torus to the intended fillet/adjacent geometry.

result_fields.name: fillet_radius_record
result_fields.description: Minor/fillet radius, torus identity, association evidence, and unit.

procedure: Resolve one toroidal face and verify the intended adjacent-feature association.
Read the analytic minor radius once and convert to the declared unit.
If the face is not a relevant torus, return not_applicable rather than fitting a radius.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous association, non-toroidal face, incompatible unit, or nonfinite radius.
Reject major radius as the fillet radius without the declared semantic distinction.
Do not infer a fillet from appearance alone.
